description.value: Pho54 is a locally-owned Vietnamese restaurant on Shoppers Row in central Campbell River, serving traditional pho and other Vietnamese dishes with a modern twist. The restaurant also offers Boba 54 bubble tea drinks alongside its main menu. It sits in a commercial shopping strip convenient to downtown Campbell River, making it a handy meal stop for cyclists passing through town.
